ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $6.61 rider cancellation fee; inform the rider that cancellations after 3 minutes of matching are chargeable and that driver proximity/late arrival is not a ground for a fee waiver on Ryde (no free-cancel-on-ETA rule exists).

rejected_claims.reason: GPS confirms the driver was ~2.4 km from the pickup, but under NS-4 a rider's free-cancellation right depends only on elapsed time from matching; driver proximity is not a fee-waiver ground. Ryde has no rule waiving the fee when the driver is late versus ETA (NS-8, 不可引用). The complaint fails on this ground, not on the arrival facts.
